capabilities: Import YouTube and Bilibili transcripts as notes, one URL per line up to 100 per batch
Sign in to Bilibili with a QR code for account-gated captions
Transcribe unavailable captions with Groq or OpenAI speech recognition
Insert transcripts as new notes or at the selection with configurable filename and metadata templates
Pause and resume batch imports across Obsidian restarts
extras: README includes manual installation from release files and says 'Use a disposable vault first', suggesting it is not yet installed from the community directory. Warns that API keys and the Bilibili session are stored unencrypted in data.json. Documents rate-limit handling, bot-verification pauses, and possible recognition charges for retries.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch video captions or transcripts from YouTube and Bilibili into notes.
